descriptionChirho: To physically drive or herd animals (flocks, herds, donkeys) from one place to another, the basic Qal sense of moving livestock by urging them forward.
To lead or conduct people on a journey, bringing them from one place to another, used in Qal for human subjects leading others along a path or route.
To guide or lead with deliberate care and authority, the Piel intensive sense often used of God or a leader shepherding people with purposeful, sustained guidance.
To drive away or carry off by force, used of driving away captives, plunder, or people as spoil, or of God forcefully driving someone into darkness or affliction.
